import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    g = 1-np.exp(-params[0]*t**params[1])
    return (params[2] + params[3]*g + params[4]*t + params[5]*g*t
            + params[6]*t*P + params[7]*P**2 + params[8]*g*P + params[9]*g*P**3)
